subject: Transportation Systems
title: America's High-Speed Rail Problem
description: Learn America's High-Speed Rail Problem in one minute.

hook.text: America has no true high-speed rail. It's the world's largest rich country without one.

buildup.text: California's project, launched in 2008, was budgeted at $33 billion. By 2024, estimates tripled.

discovery.text: Land acquisition, environmental reviews, and lawsuit after lawsuit slow every mile of construction.

twist.text: The same distance in Spain or China gets built in half the time at a third of the cost.

climax.text: It's not that America can't build high-speed rail. It's that its system makes building anything extremely costly.

punchline.text: America's rail problem isn't technology. It's process.

quiz.question: What is the main obstacle to building high-speed rail in America?
options: High costs from land disputes, lawsuits, and regulatory complexity
